en.headline: Eighty-year-old woman dies in Wong Tai Sin estate fire as firefighters find body in unit
en.dek: Fire Services said the blaze in a low-floor flat at Lung Kwong House was extinguished about 9:16am after reports of smoke and an explosion-like sound.
body: Firefighters found the body of an 80-year-old woman inside a flat after extinguishing a fire at Wong Tai Sin Lower Estate on Sunday morning, the Fire Services Department said.

The department received a report at about 8:45am of a No. 1 alarm fire at a low-floor unit in Lung Kwong House. Crews arrived at 8:50am, deployed one hose and a breathing apparatus team, and put out the fire at 9:16am.

The body was found in the living room about two metres from the entrance. The woman lived alone in the unit, which contained large amounts of clutter including nylon bags, plastic bags and bottles piled from about 1.2 metres high up to the ceiling. A shrine was also present.

Investigators are examining the possibility that a cigarette butt or incense and joss paper accidentally ignited the clutter. The case is not considered suspicious at this stage. About 200 to 300 residents self-evacuated, and one woman in her 60s was taken to hospital after inhaling smoke but remained conscious.
Police and the Fire Services Department held a press conference later to outline the circumstances.

zh.headline: 黃大仙下邨火警奪命 八旬獨居女子在單位內被發現死亡
zh.dek: 消防處表示，龍光樓低層單位火警約上午9時16分救熄，起火單位客廳發現一具女屍。
body: 消防處表示，周日早上黃大仙下邨龍光樓一低層單位發生火警，消防員救熄後在單位內發現一名80歲女子的屍體。
消防處於約上午8時45分接報龍光樓低層單位一級火警，人員8時50分到場，出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊，至9時16分將火救熄。
屍體在客廳距離門口約兩米位置被發現。死者獨居該單位，單位內有大量雜物，包括尼龍袋、膠袋及膠桶，堆疊高度由約1.2米直至天花板，亦設有神位。
調查人員正循煙頭或香燭冥鎧意外燒著雜物的方向調查，目前事件無可疑。約200至300名居民自行疏散，一名65歲女住戶吸入濃煙後被送院，神智清醒。
警方及消防處其後召開記者會交代詳情。
